subject: Bridge-letter request to cover post-audit control period (Aurora HealthTech)
messages:
From: Ian Clarke <ian.clarke@aurorasec.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Kathy Moreno <kathy.moreno@aurorasec.com>
Date: Fri, 21 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bridge letter to cover controls operating post-report

Hi Alex,

We're in the middle of a procurement review and our compliance team has asked for a short written affirmation that Redwood's SOC 2 Type II controls have continued to operate since the period end of your report (2027-03-31) up to today (we're targeting 2027-05-29).

Specifically they want: a one-page bridging statement addressing the control areas in scope of the report, confirmation of no material control changes, and a list of supporting artifacts (audit logs, KMS rotation evidence, change-control exports). We can accept a signed bridge letter (VP Security or equivalent) and a few attachments — no formal re-audit needed.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide that? If so, what timeline and who will sign it?

Thanks,
Ian
Ian Clarke
Director, Security Programs
Aurora HealthTech
[audits@aurorasec.com]

[Attachment: Aurora_Security_Request_Form.pdf (PDF)]

From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ian Clarke <ian.clarke@aurorasec.com>
Date: Sat, 22 May 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: bridge letter to cover controls operating post-report

Ian — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide a bridge letter that covers the period 2027-04-01 through 2027-05-29. A few quick clarifying points so we scope it correctly: 

- Do you need the bridge to reference all Trust Services Criteria in scope or just Security/Availability?
- Are you ok with a signed managerial affirmation (VP Security) plus sampled evidence, or do you require an expanded evidence package?
- Do you have an internal template for the language or should we propose Redwood's standard bridge wording?

What I can commit to right now: draft by 2027-05-26, internal sign-off with VP Security by 2027-05-28, and a signed PDF + evidence bundle by 2027-05-29. We'll include: SOC 2 report (period ending 2027-03-31), short narrative statement, KMS rotation excerpt, and change-control export for the period. If you need HSM attestation or encryption key custody docs, please let me know.

I'll start the draft and loop in our compliance lead for evidence prep.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0129

Karthik / Laura — forwarding Aurora's ask. High level: they want a signed bridge for 2027-04-01 -> 2027-05-29, statement confirming no material control changes, and a small evidence set.

Karthik — can you draft a concise bridge letter (one page) using our standard language but explicitly call out the report period and the bridge period? Aim for:
- Clear statement of controls in scope (Security + Availability)
- Confirmation of no material changes during the bridge window
- Signatory: VP Security (I'll coordinate)

Laura — can you pull the evidence bundle: SOC2 PDF (20270331), KMS rotation logs for Apr/May (we can redact), and the change-control export for Q1/Q2 2027. We'll likely include the KMS rotation excerpt and a change-control CSV. If anything looks like a material control change, flag it immediately.

Internal notes: prefer to avoid rolling in too many artifacts — the procurement team said short + signed is fine.

Thanks — Alex
